Daher auch der Name Hühnergott. Später kam der Glaube hinzu, ein Hühnergott bringe auch den Menschen Glück. Mir scheint, ein bißchen glaubt jeder an solche Glücksbringer: die einen mit kindlich-vertrauensseliger Offenheit, die anderen heimlich, mit mürrischer Verbissenheit. Ich glaube heimlich daran. examples.en: A self-bored stone – that is a small stone found by the sea with a little hole [in it]. Thus the [self-bored stone′s local] name “hen′s god”. Later the belief additionally arose that self-bored stones would bring people good luck. It appears to me that everyone believes in such lucky charms: some with childlike-credulous openness, others privily, with grumpy doggedness. I privily believe in it. Every time I had been by the sea I wished so hard to find a self-bored stone, but especially in this summer.
